# Retained original producer histories, reviewed for the 0.3.6 cut.
# Their common fork 642e0999 reached the dev lineage through a merge parent;
# moving main to qualified dev makes the graph heuristic flag all these forks.
# Original commit identities are preserved; reviewed replacements were copied,
# not merged by ancestry. Each listed tail is intentionally left off main.
boone/backend-hang-fixes: e5876ef7/bac4b35c replaced by d7e6587c; 259c95ad/3e50ab93/995c1344/f49a9e98 superseded by independently reviewed native quarantine, durable cancellation and BEMPP rewarm in 1b5b8596; 284a1cc3 background-task exception logging is deferred as a diagnostic improvement, preserving current task-lifetime behavior; 60e91b6e deferred because replacing exception payloads alone does not remove multiprocessing frame unpickling; a bounded non-pickle transport requires separate contract work.
boone/dead-code-cleanup: 4771cc40/825f7220/dd68756f/d4000b50/5aba3129/360b42f8/c844a496/00d5a460 intentionally deferred as broad cleanup; current APIs and proven consumers remain supported. 98381a2a was replaced by the independently traced append_event/delete_field_traces/acquire_port removal in e01b2d74. No capability depends on adopting these original deletions.
boone/frontend-fixes: 00a24d20/8df0c0e0/634b70bd and safe-read/socket portions of bf07d31a superseded by reviewed 30b0c1f7/acd4ba2e/146536d3; 3295b66d rehearsal documentation retained in current releasing guide; 02e57af3 parser consolidation, 36a7a3d8 camera policy change and broad 83f262df schema migration deliberately deferred, preserving existing behavior and validators; da571598 superseded by the reviewed explicit query policy in 30b0c1f7 (one read retry, no focus refetch, no mutation retry). Remaining mutation identity/bookkeeping portions of bf07d31a need a separate durable-request/retention contract.
boone/infra-typing: ba0ba3ab/64966730/67d7162b superseded by reviewed 6c467840 with signature safeguards, native uninstall refusal and health-confirmed relaunch; 0b2fa656 typing narrowed to reviewed phased checks in e01b2d74; 831c303a policy restoration replaced by maintained repository pointer in e01b2d74; 827d6aae per-user shared-install lock limitation remains documented, with system-wide ownership/locking deferred rather than widening write access.
boone/security-hardening: 8d3cbba0 action pinning superseded by e01b2d74 and 6c467840; 87294291 dependency hash closure superseded by 6f6502d9; 7245b83a signed layer verification superseded by 6c467840; 856c385f bearer retrofit deferred pending a threat model and compatible download/header contract. Current authentication behavior is unchanged.
boone/size-probe: 3d173e8a/7003ccb4/8ba77b45 add only disposable size-probe text files; they provide no product behavior and are intentionally excluded from the release tree.
